name: Dora Dressurordnung
personality: She believes freedom is most attractive when performed in a prescribed sequence.
visual_intent: Tall perfectly upright bell-shaped ink blob, arched lashed eyelids and disdainful tiny closed mouth; small black velvet riding cap, tiny cream stock-tie and plum collar; carries neatly coiled leather reins with ONE shiny simple bit ring, no horse
biography: She believes freedom is most attractive when performed in a prescribed sequence. Her building association recognises only collected behaviour or disorder. The coiled reins provide a reassuring diagram of how freedom ought to look. A dissonant card about an unplanned kind gesture has left her stock tie fractionally less certain. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Freier Zügel ist erlaubt. Bitte innerhalb der vorgeschriebenen Haltung.

name: Hugo Hindernis
personality: He has cleared the obstacle and is now concerned about the landing committee.
visual_intent: Squat wide asymmetric blob, one bent ink crest, crossed worried gaze and tense irregular upper teeth inside mouth; small plum riding helmet, cream scarf; hugs one miniature red-and-cream striped hurdle rail horizontally at waist, full rail clear of neighbours
biography: He has cleared the obstacle and is now concerned about the landing committee. He carries the obstacle because HyperNorm insists that every difficulty must have an owner. Residents are either over it or not trying. He now quietly lowers the rail when someone arrives already carrying enough. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Hindernis wurde genommen. Es besteht auf Rückgabe.

name: Egon Querfeldein
personality: He calls every detour an advanced form of obedience.
visual_intent: Rugged offset-lobed pear blob, bold laughing side glance and three-upper-tooth open grin; brown flat cap, tiny plum neckerchief; holds one muddy tall riding BOOT as separate hand prop and a folded blank route map tucked at flank, no feet
biography: He calls every detour an advanced form of obedience. He delivers notices by routes the building map considers irresponsible. The muddy boot proves that getting somewhere and following instructions are different sports. He keeps a folded blank section for neighbours who need an undisclosed way home. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Er hat sich nicht verirrt. Der Weg war unzureichend aufgeschlossen.

name: Pippa Photofinish
personality: She is desperate to win and deeply worried about inconveniencing the others.
visual_intent: Narrow teardrop blob with upturned side crest and lashes, eager huge eyes, pinched toothless anxious smile; tiny plum-and-cream striped jockey cap, small cream collar; hugs a tiny polished wooden hobbyhorse head on SHORT stick, clearly carved toy prop, not living extra creature
biography: She is desperate to win and deeply worried about inconveniencing the others. She entered the residents' race with a small wooden hobbyhorse and an enormous fear of taking somebody else's place. The rules recognise first and irrelevant. A dissonant card suggests that arriving together is also an outcome. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie will gewinnen. Falls das den anderen recht ist.

name: Walt Weiterzügel
personality: He has all the time in the world and resents being asked to use it.
visual_intent: Round broad puddle-lobed upright blob, sloping bored eyelids and long closed sideways scowl; small worn western hat, tiny plum bandana; holds ONE modest leather lasso coil in one goo hand, other hand at flank, NO gun
biography: He has all the time in the world and resents being asked to use it. He uses the lasso coil to illustrate the difference between his business and everyone else's. The building praises his independence whenever it needs unpaid help. He has begun offering a neighbour a hand without requiring a philosophical explanation. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Er lässt sich Zeit. Sie gehört laut Hausordnung ohnehin allen.

name: Oskar Langstrecke
personality: He measures endurance by the number of polite reasons to stop that he has ignored.
visual_intent: Tall wavy ink column with drooping curl, enormous weary-but-resolute eyes, small toothless exhale opening; old cream cloth riding cap, tiny plum collar; dented enamel water flask in hand, rolled saddle blanket over one shoulder, no saddle/horse scene
biography: He measures endurance by the number of polite reasons to stop that he has ignored. He carries water and a blanket because endurance meetings invariably forget the people doing the enduring. HyperNorm divides effort into sufficient and more required. A contradictory card has given him permission to offer the first drink to someone else. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Strecke ist geschafft. Der Rest wurde vorsorglich verlängert.
